symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on lower leaves leading to yellowing
preventive_measures: Crop rotation and avoid overhead watering

symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on upper leaf surfaces and stunted leaf growth
preventive_measures: Ensure good air circulation and use sulfur-based fungicide

symptoms: Angular yellow spots on upper leaf surface with purplish gray mold underneath
preventive_measures: Reduce humidity and space plants adequately

symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf tips with rapid foliage decay
preventive_measures: Use certified disease-free seed tubers and copper fungicides

symptoms: Sunken dark leathery spots at blossom end of fruit due to calcium deficiency and water stress
preventive_measures: Maintain consistent irrigation schedule and conduct routine soil calcium tests

symptoms: Circular dark brown to black spots with fringed margins on upper leaf surfaces surrounded by yellow halos leading to premature defoliation
preventive_measures: Prune infected foliage avoid overhead watering and ensure adequate air circulation
